items.title: [ClinicalTrials] Efficacy, Safety, and Pharmacokinetics of Vericiguat in Pediatric Participants With Heart Failure Due to Left Ventricular Systolic Dysfunction (MK-1242-036) (Phase 2/Phase 3, RECRUITING)
items.snippet: NCT ID: NCT05714085 | Sponsor: Merck Sharp & Dohme LLC | Condition: Heart Failure, Left Ventricular Systolic Dysfunction | Phase: Phase 2/Phase 3 | Status: RECRUITING. This study aims to compare the efficacy of vericiguat versus placebo on change in n-terminal pro-brain natriuretic peptide (NTproBNP) from baseline to Week 16 of the Base Period. The primary hypothesis is that vericiguat is superior to placebo in reducing NT-proBNP at Week 16 of the Base Period.

items.snippet: NCT ID: NCT07204275 | Sponsor: Vertex Pharmaceuticals Incorporated | Condition: Primary Membranous Nephropathy | Phase: Phase 2/Phase 3 | Status: RECRUITING. items.title: [ClinicalTrials] A Follow-up Study of Mezagitamab in Adults With Chronic Primary Immune Thrombocytopenia (Phase 3, RECRUITING)
items.snippet: NCT ID: NCT06948318 | Sponsor: Takeda | Condition: Immune Thrombocytopenic Purpura (ITP) | Phase: Phase 3 | Status: RECRUITING. Primary immune thrombocytopenia (ITP) is a condition where the immune system mistakenly destroys platelets, which are cells that help stop bleeding. This leads to a lower number of platelets, making it easier to bruise or bleed.
